claims.citation: New York Herald, 22 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Bark Gustav (Brem), Callin, Havre Dec 16, via Milford, E,
April 6, where she put in for repairs, having, during a heavy
gale, sprung foremast, stove bulwarks, lost sails, cutwater,
and leaking badly; has a general cargo, and is consigned to
Boyd & Hincken.
